direction_selection: training-only; coefficients learned without outer-holdout labels

A.name: log relative turnover 20 observations
A.formula_expr: iif(count(turnover_rate - turnover_rate, 20) == 20 and lowest(turnover_rate, 20) >= 0 and turnover_rate > 0, log(turnover_rate / mean(turnover_rate, 20)), None)

B.name: log relative turnover x previous-observation price change
B.formula_expr: iif(count(turnover_rate - turnover_rate, 20) == 20 and lowest(turnover_rate, 20) >= 0 and turnover_rate > 0 and count(close - close, 2) == 2 and lowest(close, 2) > 0, log(turnover_rate / mean(turnover_rate, 20)) * pct_change(close, 1), None)

limits: No predictive value claimed by compiler or worked examples.
20 means per-symbol actual bar observations, not 20 exchange sessions.
B pct_change(close,1) uses previous actual observation; resumption gaps may span market sessions.
A uniform positive unit multiplier cancels; historical mixed-unit records are not repaired.
Current zero turnover is excluded; historical zeros are allowed only inside a complete finite nonnegative window.
Normalization uses each full-market date cross-section; max_symbols output truncation does not define universe.
